name: Clipped Scroll Gallery
description: Pinned scroll sequence where a 3D perspective image collage zooms toward the viewer, followed by full-screen slides that wipe away with clip-path while a thumbnail stack reveals in sync.
contents: Header and footer labels around the sequence
Perspective collage of images at configurable positions
Slides with blurred background image, title and meta lines
behavior: Gallery section is pinned and scrubbed: the wrapper moves along Z while each image scales up
Slide section is pinned and each slide clip-path wipes upward to reveal the next
Thumbnails wipe in sync with a scrub lag
Layout refreshes on prop changes and all triggers are reverted on unmount
editableByProps: Images, alt text, slide titles and meta lines
Collage positions, sizes and zoom amounts
Background and text colors, header and footer labels
Scroll lengths, blur, thumbnail size and position

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the wipe direction of slides

fixed: Pins two sections with GSAP ScrollTrigger and adds scroll distance to the page
Includes full-screen spacer blocks between the gallery and slides (spacerCount) to give scroll room
Image index slots are shared between the collage and slides and wrap around the images array
